title: AquaLobby
description: AquaLobby the only Lobby plugin you will ever need
body:
AquaLobby is a high-end hub management solution designed to provide your players with a seamless and immersive transition into the Aqua ecosystem. It combines robust world protection with elegant, thematic navigation tools to ensure your server's first impression is as polished as a royal treasure. From bioluminescent join titles to custom teleportation effects, AquaLobby turns your spawn into a breathtaking entryway to the Sunken Sovereignty.

🔱 Key Features
Immersive Spawn Handling: Set dynamic spawn points with custom "Deep-Dive" arrival effects, featuring unique water particles and ambient sounds.

Royal Navigation Menus: Fully customizable, Aqua-themed GUI wrappers for server selectors, player settings, and shop links—all powered by the AquaLib UI engine.

Abyssal Protection: Integrated lobby management to disable hunger, fall damage, block breaking, and weather cycles without the need for additional heavy plugins.

Atmospheric Messaging: Professional, localized join and leave messages, action bars, and screen titles styled with a cohesive oceanic color palette.

Bioluminescent Visibility: Toggleable player visibility settings to ensure your lobby remains high-performance even during peak player counts.

🛠️ Technical Integration
Ecosystem Ready: Built to work natively with Aqua Kingdoms and requires AquaLib for core functionality.

PlaceholderAPI Support: Fully compatible with PAPI for displaying player stats and server information within its custom menus.

Optimized Logic: Minimalistic tick-usage ensures that your lobby server maintains a perfect 20.0 TPS even with hundreds of concurrent connections.
